title: Centred carousel with blur-peek neighbours and a velocity-graded snap
summary: Centred card sharp, neighbours at `.2` + `blur(6px)` (`.1`, no blur, ≤ 920 px), gap computed from a fixed peek (`10 %` / `14 %` of the width), release speed picks the snap (`> 1.2 px/ms` → `320 ms` crisp curve, slow `450–600 ms` soft curve), rubber-band overscroll returned by a critically damped spring stepped exactly with the shared ticker's `dt`; links in a list with roving `tabindex`, arrow / Home / End keys, a live "n of N"; blur kept but instant, snaps instant under reduced motion
variants: flat row with blur-peek neighbours, velocity-graded snap and a rubber-band spring on the shared ticker (this, default)
CSS-3D coverflow ring: 54 % translate, 300 px depth and 38° per step, two neighbours each side at .55 / .22 opacity
